_comment: Eat-in (issue #134 phase 1). The seats of an eat-in counter are the floor tiles in front of it (its access side). After paying, a customer whose basket holds something to eat here sits at a free seat with the highest eat_share of its categories (decided by a hash of the customer id: no random draw) and stays stay_game_seconds (by the same hash) before leaving; with no free seat it simply leaves. Sales are booked at the till as before; a seat never causes a second checkout. Benefits for the average spend or reputation are a later phase. Initial values.
